channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Israel says it killed Hezbollah commander in first strike on Beirut since ceasefire
item.description: Israel killed a Hezbollah commander in a strike on Beirut, the first since the ceasefire, prompting Hezbollah to fire and launch drones at Israeli soldiers. Iran ally Hezbollah has responded to those strikes by firing and launching armed drones towards Israeli soldiers.

item.title: Trump says war will be ‘over quickly’ as Israel hits Beirut for first time since ceasefire
item.description: US President Donald Trump said the war with Iran would be over quickly after Israel launched airstrikes on Beirut for the first time since the ceasefire. The attacks targeted Iranian-backed Hezbollah militants in the Lebanese capital.

item.title: One year after India-Pakistan clash, a fragile truce holds amid rising risks
item.description: A fragile truce holds between India and Pakistan one year after their clash, with Kashmir remaining a key dispute hindering stability. At the heart of the dispute remains Kashmir, a flashpoint that continues to hinder long-term stability and economic potential in South Asia.

item.title: Two Singapore residents isolated at NCID after hantavirus exposure on cruise and flight, risk to
item.description: Two Singapore residents were isolated after exposure to hantavirus on a flight and cruise. The two men were on the same flight as a confirmed hantavirus case who later died.

item.title: Venice Biennale Erupts in Protest as Russian Pavilion Locked by Sanctions
item.description: The Russian Pavilion at the Venice Biennale was locked due to sanctions, sparking protests. Venice Biennale Erupts in Protest as Russian Pavilion Locked by Sanctions Sri Lanka Guardian.

item.title: Iran reviewing U.S. proposal as Trump pressures Tehran for agreement on deal to end war
item.description: Iran is reviewing a US proposal to end the war, while denying allegations of involvement in a blast on the HMM Namu ship. Tehran’s embassy in Seoul said it “firmly rejects and categorically denies” allegations that its armed forces were behind a blast aboard the Panama-flagged HMM Namu.

item.title: Shell latest oil giant to see profits surge due to Iran war impact
item.description: Shell's profits surged by nearly a quarter due to recent oil price volatility, benefiting from the impact of the Iran war. The energy giant's financial gain is a direct result of the current market fluctuations.

item.title: Trump to Host Brazil’s President Lula at White House After Months of Ups and Downs
item.description: US President Trump will host Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the White House for talks on security, trade, and critical minerals. The meeting comes after a rocky relationship between the two leaders.

item.title: Malaysia seeks clarification from Norway after export control halts missile supply
item.description: Malaysia is seeking clarification from Norway after an export control halted the supply of missiles. Norway banned the deliveries just days before the scheduled date, according to a Malaysian defence news portal.

item.title: German Leaders Clash With Spy Chiefs Over Domestic Threat From Iran
item.description: German leaders, including Chancellor Friedrich Merz, have publicly played down the domestic threat from Iran-linked groups. Intelligence agents had privately warned of potential hybrid attacks from these groups. Intelligence agents have privately warned of the potential of hybrid attacks from Iran-linked groups.

item.title: Japan, UAE agree to hold talks on expanded oil supply and joint stockpiles
item.description: Japan and the UAE have agreed to hold talks on expanded oil supply and joint stockpiles. The discussions aim to strengthen their cooperation in the energy sector, with details of the talks yet to be announced.

item.title: French warship moves towards Hormuz for possible defensive mission
item.description: The French warship La Fayette is heading towards the Strait of Hormuz for a possible defensive mission. The move comes as Iran reviews a US proposal to end the war, which Donald Trump says could bring peace.

item.title: Security Analytics Market Surges as Cyber Threats and AI-Driven Defense Transform Cybersecurity -
item.description: Cybersecurity threats are driving growth in the security analytics market. Companies are turning to AI-driven defense solutions to protect against attacks, with market revenue surging as a result. Security Analytics Market Surges as Cyber Threats and AI-Driven Defense Transform Cybersecurity vocal. media.

item.title: The Gaza journalist killed on the day his daughter was born
item.description: Israeli forces killed Yahya Abu Arra in Gaza on the day his daughter Sana was born. Her first birthday is now shadowed by loss, with her father's death a tragic reminder of the conflict.

item.title: Judge Who Handed South Korea's Ex-First Lady 4-Year Jail Term Found Dead
item.description: A judge who sentenced South Korea's former first lady Kim Keon Hee to four years in prison has been found dead. The judge's death raises questions about the case and its outcome.

item.title: EU reaches tentative deal on simpler AI rules, plans ban on 'nudifier' apps
item.description: The European Union has agreed to ban AI-powered 'nudifier' apps that create deepfakes and sexualized imagery. The move is part of a broader effort to regulate AI use within the EU.

item.title: WHO Updates Hantavirus Outbreak Toolbox: How These Protocols Save Lives
item.description: The World Health Organization updated its Hantavirus outbreak toolbox to combat the serious viral infection. The protocols aim to save lives by providing guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and prevention. Hantavirus is a serious viral infection.

item.title: Sri Lanka’s former President Chandrika Kumaratunga wishes Vijay on ‘remarkable achievement’
item.description: Sri Lanka's former President Chandrika Kumaratunga congratulated Vijay on his achievement. She recalled the friendly ties between Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka, looking forward to continued relations.

item.title: New Zealand Sanctions 20 Russia-Linked Individuals and Entities
item.description: New Zealand imposed sanctions on 20 Russia-linked individuals and entities. The move targets those connected to Russia, as reported by Odessa Journal. New Zealand Sanctions 20 Russia-Linked Individuals and Entities Odessa Journal.

item.title: U.S. conduct diverted path of diplomacy toward threats, pressure, and sanctions
item.description: Iranian President-elect Pezeshkian stated that US conduct shifted diplomacy towards threats, pressure, and sanctions. This approach altered the diplomatic path. Pezeshkian: U. S. conduct diverted path of diplomacy toward threats, pressure, and sanctions Pars Today.
